description: Score a constraint bundle against the 6 VQP criteria (access_control CC6.1, audit_coverage CC7.2, escalation_paths CC7.4, deny_specificity CC8.1, hold_conditions CC6.3, override_governance CC5.2). Stores a tamper-evident snapshot with a SHA-256 prompt_hash in vqp_snapshots. Verdicts: qualified (≥85, no fails), conditionally_qualified (≥60), not_qualified. Requires ATLASENT_SUPABASE_URL and ATLASENT_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.

org_id.description: Organization ID that owns the bundle.

vqp_context.description: Additional context embedded in the VQP prompt for this snapshot.

name: atlasent_vqp_generate
title: AtlaSent — VQP Generate Snapshot
